note: Oilers Miri Maru and Sarawak Maru of HI-67 (Moji to Singapore via Manila), both minor damage; both reached Manila. BANG's sheets claimed 2(a) a large engine-aft freighter or tanker sunk (fits Sarawak Maru, hit in the bow), 2(b) a large passenger freighter sunk with a hole under the bridge (fits Miri Maru, hit under the bridge), and 2(c) a freighter probably sunk (no Japanese record of a third ship hit). FRUPAC relayed the claim as 2 AK sunk, 1 AK probably sunk
